summary: Model updated for the rewritten ValidateUpdate; one update-introduced chain-halt defect (MC-1) reproduced.
validation_limits: Bounded TLC exploration (height <= 2 for standard/full checks, <= 4 deep BFS, <= 6 in a 30-minute simulation); not a proof.
Runtime traces come from 20 deterministic single-process scenarios with in-memory stores; crash cuts are emulated by restart and one injected state-save failure.
Consumers of the enable height outside the scoped subsystem are checked only abstractly (P-U3).
specula ci-result and the bug-confirmation controller were unavailable; confirmation was done directly.

findings.title: Updated ValidateUpdate rejects an unchanged VoteExtensionsEnableHeight once vote extensions are enabled, halting the chain
findings.cause: The update removed ValidateUpdate's equality short-circuit; row 6 rejects any present Abci enable height <= the block height, including the unchanged, already-reached value.
findings.trigger: With vote extensions enabled, the application's FinalizeBlockResponse re-sends its unchanged Abci.VoteExtensionsEnableHeight (e.g. a full ConsensusParams echo with a Block change).
findings.consequence: ApplyBlock fails before Commit, consensus logs CONSENSUS FAILURE and stops, and the restart replay rejects the same block again: every node halts at that height.

premises: Vote extensions are enabled at the executed height (0 < VoteExtensionsEnableHeight <= header.Height).
The application returns ConsensusParamUpdates with a non-nil Abci sub-record equal to the current VoteExtensionsEnableHeight, which the ABCI contract permits (abci++_app_requirements.md:776-789).
Any ApplyBlock error is fatal in consensus and the restart replays the block through the real application deterministically.
